summary: Fixes a high-severity inline-updater outage where a failed or interrupted DjangoLux update could leave the site stuck behind the maintenance/update screen even after the runtime had healthily reverted to the baked image. reconcile() now lowers an orphaned maintenance flag once the runtime has demonstrably converged onto a healthy release and no run or image update still owns it, so a plain updater restart self-heals the outage. Adds a re-apply confirmation guard (the review modal warns and requires an explicit acknowledgment before re-installing a version whose most recent apply already failed) and a permanent skip: the admin can skip a version from the updater dialog so the check never offers it again (picking the latest non-skipped release instead) until un-skipped. Inline-safe: one backward-compatible, nullable AddField (skipped_versions) plus updater/view logic, templates, and tests.
highlights: Fixes the 'stuck on the update screen' outage: reconcile lowers an orphaned maintenance flag when the runtime is healthy on baked.
A failed/interrupted update that reverts to the baked image no longer 503s the whole site indefinitely.
A plain updater restart (compose restart/down-up) now self-heals a stuck maintenance flag.
New re-apply confirmation guard: warns and requires acknowledgment before re-installing a previously-failed version.
New permanent 'Skip this version' from the updater dialog: the check never offers a skipped version until you un-skip it.
